column3: NAUX Learn is a deliberately small profile for learning programming and practicing algorithms.
This release is not intended for
Stable API or long-term compatibility requirements.
Syntax, semantics, libraries, project formats, and installation behavior may change substantially in future releases.
Execution limits reduce accidental runaway computation; they are not a security sandbox.
Learners do not need Rust or Cargo, but this artifact is still produced by a Rust/Cargo seed and includes egg seed debt.
Future NAUX will have a broader scope; research directions are not delivery or schedule promises.
